set.name: Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution—Delta Reign
set.description: Delta Reign features Mega Rayquaza ex and three two-card Legendary Stadiums. Compare TCGplayer prices by collector number, printing, and sealed product.
set.collector_note: For a two-pocket binder spread, look for Legendary Pyroduct 094/103 and 095/103. Side by side, the two halves make one volcanic scene. Mega Rayquaza ex also appears under several collector numbers. Use the number on your card to find its price.

set_size_source: The Pokémon Company lists over 135 cards in its product showcase. The TCGCSV catalogue numbers its main set to 103 and lists additional numbered variants.
